description: Save, find and file documents in M-Files with their properties, move them through workflow states, check them out and in, and download their files.

m_files_new_document_trigger.description: Runs when a document is added to M-Files, in one class or any, with its properties and files. Documents already there when the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: Only documents of this class. Leave empty for every document.
parameters.name: class_id

m_files_object_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a document or other object changes in M-Files, once for each new version, with its properties as they are now. Choose a property to run only when that property's value changes.

parameters.description: Only objects of this class. Leave empty for every class.
parameters.name: class_id

parameters.description: Run only when this property's value changes. Leave empty for any change.
